samples_reviewed.question_text: Write one third in fraction notation.
hints: A fraction shows how many equal parts are shaded out of the total.
The denominator (bottom number) tells the total equal parts: 3.
The numerator (top number) tells how many parts are taken: 1.
So the fraction is 1/3.
